author: Insta360
description:
There's a gap between shooting something and actually posting it. Most footage never survives it.

X6 closes that gap. Zero Editing is four parts working together, from the AI model underneath to the cloud tools on top, and it starts the moment you plug the camera in.

Insta360 PanoMind is our in-house 360 multimodal AI model, built to actually understand 360 footage, and it powers it all:
AI Director: The editor that lives in your camera, finding your highlights while it charges and sending a finished clip to your phone.
Auto Edit 2.0: Pick your footage and tap once to get a finished clip, so edits take seconds instead of evenings.
Moments Pro: Our biggest update yet to Insta360+ Cloud, letting you shape your clip's style in a few words. Powered by Gemini.

Shoot now. Edit never. Insta360 X6 lands August 12.

Learn more: https://bit.ly/x6preheat_ytb

#Insta360ZeroEdit #Insta360X6
